## Appearance

Mrs. Allan possesses a lovely smile. Her cheeks feature exquisite dimples.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009)_

## Personality

Allan is described as a bright, gentle, and cheerful individual. As a young girl, she was a dreadful mischief who was constantly getting into scrapes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025)_

## History

Mrs. Allan was once a self-described girlhood mischief who had also struggled with geometry in school. After arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a bride, she attended a tea party at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where she kindly comforted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl mistakenly flavored a cake with anodyne liniment, inviting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to show her the flower garden. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan acts as a valued friend, mentor, and extra conscience to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship began when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was a Sunday school student eager to welcome the new minister's wife, though their initial meeting involved [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serving Mrs. Allan a cake flavored with liniment. Mrs. Allan graciously comforted the mortified girl, and over time they developed a deep bond, offering each other comfort in times of grief and sharing thoughtful walks where they discuss teaching, ideals, and the value of their friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), +24 more_
